result.summary: Found 3 issues: 1 major content issue, 1 minor styling issue, 1 minor content issue.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated and appears to be cut off, which is not just a scrollable row partial item issue here because the name is truncated beyond the right edge in a way that the full name is unreadable even with scrolling.
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names fit within the card width, or use ellipses with a tooltip to show the full name on hover/tap, or adjust the card layout to accommodate longer names.

issues.description: The notification bell icon has a red dot indicating unread notifications, but the dot is positioned slightly off-center and could be more prominent for better visual clarity.
issues.suggestion: Center the red notification dot on the bell icon and make it slightly larger to improve visibility.

issues.description: The text 'Fastest near you' and 'Popular right now' section titles are clear, but the delivery time range for 'Green Bowl Poké' (15-25 min) is inconsistent with others (20-30 min) in the same section, which might cause user confusion without clear explanation.
issues.suggestion: Add a note explaining delivery time estimates vary by distance or restaurant, or standardize the time range format for clarity.
